description: Workflow gate for Bench P4 W1 — CSV report CLI: robust parsing, schema validation, output formats (Arm C: Invoker DAG, mixed Codex)

config.prompt:
Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Extend aggregation: --group-by with optional --sum <col> (column sum_<col>, rounded to 2 decimals) and --count (column count); groups sorted by key ascending; column order group, sum, count. Without --group-by output rows as-is. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Make argument handling strict: unknown flags, missing input file, unreadable file, and bad --format exit 1 with a stderr message starting with 'usage:' or 'error:'. Review the whole change against SPEC.md, fill missing tests, and update README.md.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Add --format table|csv|json (default table) and --out <path> exactly as in SPEC.md: json pretty-printed with 2-space indent and trailing newline with numbers as JSON numbers; csv quoted only when needed with \n line endings and trailing newline; --out writes the file and leaves stdout empty. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Replace the naive comma splitter with an RFC 4180 parser: quoted fields, escaped quotes, commas and newlines inside quotes, CRLF or LF, optional UTF-8 BOM, optional trailing newline; the first record is the header. Keep Node built-ins only. Add parser tests for each edge case.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Add --schema <file.json> validation exactly as in SPEC.md: types string, integer, number, date (real YYYY-MM-DD), boolean; required, enum, min, max; missing schema column error; one stderr line per invalid cell as 'row <n>: <column>: <message>' with 1-based data row numbers; exit 2 with empty stdout by default; --skip-invalid drops invalid rows and prints 'skipped <k> invalid row(s)'. Convert integer and number columns to numbers. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.
